Ella, Sri Lanka

Places to visit

Waterfalls, peaks, tea country and the famous blue train — all minutes from your room. We arrange tuk-tuks, guides and early breakfasts; every trip is booked straight on WhatsApp.

2.5 km from the hotel

Nine Arch Bridge

The iconic blue train crosses the nine arches framed by jungle — walk the tracks from Ella town and watch it pass.

3 km from the hotel

Ella Rock

A rewarding sunrise hike above the valley with sweeping views over the hill country. We arrange guides and early breakfast.

1.5 km from the hotel

Little Adam's Peak

An easy 45-minute climb through tea fields to a 360° viewpoint — perfect at sunrise or golden hour.

4 km from the hotel

Ravana Falls

One of Sri Lanka's widest waterfalls, tumbling over rock ledges — swim at the base or visit Ravana Cave above.

3 km from the hotel

Tea Plantation & Factory

Walk emerald tea rows and see how Ceylon tea is made — tasting included.

6 km from the hotel

Mahamevnawa Buddhist Monastery

A serene white pagoda monastery above the valley — peaceful grounds, monks at chant and wide mountain views.

3.5 km from the hotel

Kombukara Nature Pool & Waterfall

A hidden natural swimming pool at the top of a waterfall, tucked in the jungle beyond Kithal Ella — perfect for a cool dip.

2 km from the hotel

Halpe Tea Factory

A family-run working tea factory in Kithal Ella — see the rolling, drying and sorting, then taste fresh Ceylon tea.

2.5 km from the hotel

Pallewela Secret Waterfall

A quiet waterfall most visitors never find — a short tuk-tuk ride and a small walk, and you often have it to yourselves.

4 km from the hotel

Demodara View Point

Look straight down at the famous Demodara loop, where the track spirals under the station and the valley opens around it.

4 km from the hotel

Demodara Station

The colonial-era station at the centre of the railway loop — the turning point of the most scenic rail line in the world.

Trip prices are confirmed before departure — no online payment needed.
